author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
It's not just spaceship models on display at the WonderFest modelmaking show. We meet up with machinist and longtime Tested member Chris Lawson who brought his collection of Star Wars hand prop builds to the show. From rangefinders to comlinks, we love these builds that combine vintage camera gear with custom machined parts!

Find more of Chris's prop builds at https://www.instagram.com/c2_models_and_props/
Watch more videos from WonderFest here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAeisqS5CxeSZ5MRXtlTULAqo
Learn more about WonderFest at https://www.wonderfest.com/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
